title: City Collage Travel Postcard
summary: A 3:4 travel postcard for any city: handwritten city name, a collage of real landmarks, a slogan and a line of poetry, a city map, a stamp with today's postmark and the coordinates.
seoTitle: City Collage Travel Postcard Prompt | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Generate a modern collage postcard for any city with landmarks, a map, a stamp and postmark, and the city's coordinates. Pick a city, then copy the prompt.
inputRequirement: No image needed. Pick a city, or choose "Fill in your own" and replace it with any city. Add "Dragon Boat Festival" after the city name for the festival version.
howToUse: Pick a city in the prompt, or choose "Fill in your own" and type yours.
Copy the prompt, or open it directly in ChatGPT.
Send it; the model fills in the landmarks, slogan, poem, coordinates and date.
